stories.title: Frontend CI/CD pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Create GitHub Actions workflow for rn-app: lint (eslint), type check (tsc --noEmit), unit tests (jest), on PR to main. Add required checks.

stories.title: Performance baseline and monitoring
acceptanceCriteria: Measure and document: JS bundle size, app startup time (TTI), FPS during scrolling. Set up performance budgets. Add React.memo and useMemo where needed.

stories.title: App store metadata preparation
acceptanceCriteria: Prepare: app name, description, keywords, screenshots (from Maestro), privacy policy URL, support URL. Configure in eas.json submit profile.

stories.title: Unit tests for all shared components
acceptanceCriteria: Write Jest tests for all 14 shared components: Screen, Text, PrimaryButton, TextButton, TextInput, PhoneInput, OTPInput, DottedPattern, DocumentUploadCard, FileUploadZone, Logo, ConsentToggle, CarouselDots, ErrorBoundary. Test rendering, props, interactions.

stories.title: Unit tests for Zustand stores and custom hooks
acceptanceCriteria: Test all stores (authStore, waitlistStore + new ones from C01-C03). Test all custom hooks with @testing-library/react-hooks. Cover state transitions and edge cases.

stories.title: Integration tests for service layer
acceptanceCriteria: Test API service wrappers against Supabase branch. Cover: auth flow (sendOtp→verifyOtp), payment flow (initiate→webhook→status), waitlist flow (join→status→approve).

stories.title: Maestro functional flows — per-screen
acceptanceCriteria: Write Maestro flow YAML for each of the 21 screen routes. Each flow: launch app, navigate to screen, verify key elements visible, test interactions. Store in rn-app/.maestro/screens/.

stories.title: Maestro E2E journey flows
acceptanceCriteria: Write 5 multi-screen Maestro journeys: (1) Auth: splash→carousel→sign-up→OTP→waitlist, (2) Onboarding: agreement→setup→bank→landlord, (3) Payment success: home→select→add-upi→processing→success, (4) Payment failure flow, (5) Profile flow. Store in rn-app/.maestro/journeys/.

stories.title: Maestro Cloud regression pipeline
acceptanceCriteria: Set up Maestro Cloud: EAS e2e-test build profile, upload flow, tag-based filtering (regression/smoke/e2e). Run after every parity-achieved screen.

stories.title: CI integration for test automation
acceptanceCriteria: Add Maestro Cloud to GitHub Actions for PR checks. Run smoke tests on every PR, full regression on merge to main. Report results as PR checks.
